import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1050;
    static int Mod;
    static int[][] C = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] f = new int[MAXN], g = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][][] dp = new int[MAXN][MAXN][2];

    static int add(int a, int b) {
        return a + b >= Mod ? a + b - Mod : a + b;
    }

    static int subtract(int a, int b) {
        return a - b < 0 ? a - b + Mod : a - b;
    }

    static int multiply(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((long)a * b % Mod);
    }

    static void update(int[] a, int index, int value) {
        a[index] = add(a[index], value);
    }

    static void prepare_combinations(int n) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                C[i][j] = add(C[i - 1][j - 1], C[i - 1][j]);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        Mod = sc.nextInt();

        f[1] = 2;
        g[1] = 0;
        int limit = Math.max(m, n - m + 1);
        prepare_combinations(limit);

        for (int i = 2; i <= m; ++i) {
            f[i] = multiply(f[i - 1], 2 * (i + 1));
            g[i] = multiply(g[i - 1], 2 * (i + 1));
            update(g, i, multiply(f[i - 1], i * (i - 1)));
            for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
                int k = i - j - 1;
                int c = multiply(C[j + k][j], j + k + 2);
                f[i] = add(f[i], multiply(c, multiply(f[j], f[k])));
                g[i] = add(g[i], multiply(c, multiply(f[j], g[k])));
                g[i] = add(g[i], multiply(c, multiply(g[j], f[k])));
                int w = j * (j + 1) / 2 + k * (k + 1) / 2;
                g[i] = add(g[i], multiply(multiply(C[j + k][j], w), multiply(f[j], f[k])));
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j)
                for (int o = 0; o < 2; ++o)
                    dp[i][j][o] = 0;
        dp[0][0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                for (int o = 0; o < 2; ++o) {
                    int c = dp[i][j][o];
                    if (c != 0) {
                        if (o == 0) {
                            for (int k = 1; k + j <= m; ++k) {
                                update(dp[i + 1], j + k, multiply(multiply(c, C[j + k][k]), f[k]));
                                update(dp[i + 1], j + k, multiply(multiply(c, C[j + k][k]), g[k]));
                            }
                        } else {
                            for (int k = 1; k + j <= m; ++k) {
                                update(dp[i + 1], j + k, multiply(multiply(c, C[j + k][k]), f[k]));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int answer = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            answer = add(answer, multiply(dp[i][m][1], C[n - m + 1][i]));
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
